lane_single_method_paragraph: Hydrothermal-Scarp-Lineament & Visible-Fault Continuation (H77-HSL): Executing the documented next steps from the three prior GEMSDOE77 lanes, we train a spatially-blocked HGB ranker over (1) the full 12-band 1 m USGS 3DEP lidar scarp block with derived crest-toe Laplacian curvature dipole, unilateral facing polarity, and multi-cell sub-pixel spin-2 strike director continuity (H77-HSL-1), (2) the 150 m upward-continued magnetic vertical-continuation residual (TMI minus TMI_up150) and hydrothermal magnetite-destruction / smectite clay-cap conduit index (H77-HSL-2), (3) INGENIOUS GDR 1391 geothermal outflow (thermal spring/well temperatures, quartz/chalcedony/cation geothermometers, and Quaternary volcanic vents, strictly excluding any fault-distance column; H77-HSL-3), (4) the corrected potential-field contact-physics and range-front-base channels from PR #5, and (5) in the structural arm, visible-fault-only multi-scale damage-zone density, stepover relay deficit, and lidar-to-host strike alignment derived strictly from fold-visible faults (H77-HSL-4). Dots are emitted off-catalogue (>3 px) via submodular 300 m triangular-kernel marginal-gain selection under a minimum spacing of 2.8 px and verified against all 808 registry rasters plus the 3 prior GEMSDOE77 lane rasters.
prior_session_next_steps_addressed: Contact-physics lane (PR #5) Next Step 2a: promote the 1 m lidar scarp block from ablation into a primary preregistered candidate and expand from 5 raw bands to all 12 bands plus crest-toe dipole, facing polarity, and sub-pixel strike director continuity.

Contact-physics lane (PR #5) Next Step 2b: evaluate on both the whole-component hide-and-recover holdout (seeds 30 and 21, 22,914 withheld pixels) and the secondary SGMC off-catalogue proxy (62,122 proxy pixels).

LIA lane (PR #6) Next Step 3: construct a high-resolution 1 m lidar + multi-physics + hydrothermal detector capable of earning credit away from the H19-5 support while respecting the <=0.70 3-px overlap limit against all 765 informative registry rasters.

Selective-U lane (PR #3) Next Step 3: evaluate against fold-recomputed, visible-fault-only incumbents (C1_champion_vis, C2_standard, C3_contactphys) on identical spatial folds with paired 20 km physical-block bootstrap CIs.

Standing prompt geothermal research directive: incorporate official INGENIOUS GDR 1391 geothermal well/spring temperature and chemical geothermometer data, Quaternary volcanic vents, and upward-continued aeromagnetic continuation residuals.

hypotheses_ranked.name: 1 m USGS 3DEP Lidar Scarp Crest-Toe Curvature Dipole, Facing Polarity, and Sub-Pixel Strike Director Continuity
layers: external/lidar_scarp_features_u8.tif bands 1-12 (ex_max, ex_mean, step_max, lapneg_max, lappos_max, downface_max, upface_max, cross_max, relief, coh100, strike, valid)
hypotheses_ranked.signature: Crest-toe curvature dipole sqrt(lapneg_max * lappos_max) * cross_max; unilateral facing polarity |downface_max - upface_max| / (downface_max + upface_max + eps) * step_max; spin-2 axial director coherence of sub-pixel 1 m strike at sigma=2 px (200 m) and sigma=5 px (500 m); Hessian ridge of step_max * coh100 at sigma=2 px.
hypotheses_ranked.why_missing_from_catalogue: 1:250k-1:24k airphoto compilations missed low-throw (<1-2 m) or fan-breached scarps that 1 m bare-earth lidar resolves through paired crest-toe curvature and multi-cell sub-pixel strike collinearity.
hypotheses_ranked.non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan wave-cut shoreline scarps, fluvial terrace risers along the Humboldt/Carson/Walker rivers, and road/railroad grades.
hypotheses_ranked.difference_vs_repo: PR #5 excluded lidar from its primary arm and only used 5 raw uint8 bands in ablation; Bands 2, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 11 and all dipole/polarity/director transforms are untried in GEMSDOE77.

hypotheses_ranked.name: Shallow Vertical Magnetic Continuation Residual (TMI - TMI_up150m) & Hydrothermal Demagnetization Conduit
hypotheses_ranked.signature: Vertical continuation dipole residual rank01(tmi) - rank01(TMI_up150) and its gradient magnitude; hydrothermal magnetite-destruction / smectite clay-cap index rank01(cond_surf) * (1 - rank01(mag_as)) * rank01(|grad(cond_surf)|); U/Th radiometric mobility.
hypotheses_ranked.why_missing_from_catalogue: Concealed intra-basin faults beneath young playa/alluvial cover lack surface scarps but offset shallow (<150-300 m) volcanic layers and host hydrothermal fluid pathways that destroy magnetite and form conductive clay caps.
hypotheses_ranked.non_fault_mimic: Saline playa evaporite/clay pans (high conductivity and low magnetic gradient without structural throw) and stratabound altered tuffs.
hypotheses_ranked.difference_vs_repo: No lane in GEMSDOE77 read Band 3 (UTh) or Band 4 (TMI_up150) of geodawn_extensions_u8.tif.

hypotheses_ranked.name: INGENIOUS GDR 1391 Geothermal Outflow (Thermal Springs, Silica/Cation Geothermometers) & Quaternary Volcanic Vent Alignment
layers: external/gdr_wellspring_in_footprint.csv (row, col, thermalclass, temp_c, geothermquartz_c, geothermchalc_c, geothermcat_c; dist_known_fault_px strictly excluded)
hypotheses_ranked.signature: Log-distance to hot/warm springs and wells (T >= 35 C); multi-scale Gaussian thermal excess (sigma=4, 12 px) and chemical geothermometer excess (max of quartz, chalcedony, Na-K-Ca >= 70 C at sigma=8 px); log-distance to Quaternary volcanic vents.
hypotheses_ranked.why_missing_from_catalogue: Over 70% of Great Basin geothermal systems are 'blind' (no prominent surface scarp at the upflow zone due to sinter/playa cover), yet thermal wells, silica/cation geothermometers, and Quaternary dike vents localize the controlling dilational fault stepovers and terminations.
hypotheses_ranked.non_fault_mimic: Lateral warm-water outflow plumes in permeable alluvial fan aquifers down-gradient from range-front faults.
hypotheses_ranked.difference_vs_repo: No lane in GEMSDOE77 loaded gdr_wellspring_in_footprint.csv or gdr_volcanic_vents_in_footprint.csv.

hypotheses_ranked.name: Visible-Fault-Only Multi-Scale Damage-Zone Density, Stepover Relay Deficit, and Lidar-to-Host Strike Alignment + Submodular 300 m Kernel Emission
layers: fold['visible'] fault mask in holdout folds (catalogue in final full fit), strictly buffered by >3 px from withheld truth
Band 11 (lidar strike) and Band 12 (det_elev) axial orientation
hypotheses_ranked.signature: Log Euclidean distance to nearest visible fault (at d > 3 px); Gaussian visible-fault densities at sigma=5, 15, 35 px; relay-stepover deficit ratio dens_s15 / (dens_s5 + 0.01); axial alignment cos(2*(theta_lidar - theta_vis)) between 1 m lidar scarp strike and nearest visible fault strike; submodular 300 m triangular-kernel marginal-coverage dot emission.
hypotheses_ranked.why_missing_from_catalogue: Organizer Forum 11536 states 'new fault' includes newly mapped geometry (splays, relay ramps, stepovers, tip extensions) of existing fault systems. Displacement transfers across stepover gaps along collinear or conjugate strikes.
hypotheses_ranked.non_fault_mimic: Piedmont bajada contours and parallel distributor channels flanking a mapped range-front fault.
hypotheses_ranked.difference_vs_repo: Neither PR #3, PR #5, nor PR #6 trained a supervised model combining visible-fault-only structural features with the 12-band lidar + geophysical + hydrothermal stack or submodular 300 m kernel coverage emission.

hypotheses_ranked.name: Relocated Sub-km Microseismicity Lineaments (USGS ComCat / UNR NSL / 2020 M6.5 Monte Cristo Range Rupture)
layers: External free official source: https://earthquake.usgs.gov/fdsnws/event/1/query (USGS ComCat FDSN API)
hypotheses_ranked.signature: Sub-km epicentral streak density and focal-mechanism nodal-plane alignment.
hypotheses_ranked.why_missing_from_catalogue: Active blind strike-slip and normal faults in the Walker Lane (such as the 2020 M6.5 Monte Cristo Range rupture inside the GeoDAWN footprint) rupture unmapped intra-basin strands.
hypotheses_ranked.non_fault_mimic: Distributed swarm seismicity from geothermal injection/production or volcanic diking.
hypotheses_ranked.difference_vs_repo: DATA-BLOCKED in this sandbox (earthquake.usgs.gov outside sandbox egress allowlist); shipped bands 10 and 16 are 100 km-smoothed rate-density grids.

experiments_budget.exp1: Build 77-channel HSL stack, run leakage canary on all 77 channels (stop if any symmetric AUC > 0.90), run seed-30 buffered whole-component quadrant holdout (11,342 withheld positives) across C0_random, C1_champion_vis, C2_standard, C3_contactphys, C4_contactphys_lidar5, HSL_nolabel, HSL_structural, and submodular 300 m kernel emission.
experiments_budget.exp2: Replicate on independent seed-21 buffered whole-component quadrant holdout (11,572 withheld positives), compute two-draw pooled summary (22,914 withheld positives, 1,000 paired 20 km block bootstrap draws), SGMC off-catalogue proxy (62,122 pixels), and LIA live-inversion projection diagnostic.
experiments_budget.exp3: Build full-catalogue candidate GeoTIFF + single-TIFF ZIP via shared gems57.submission_writer, run Phase-1 (surface) and Phase-2 (dots) uniqueness audit against all 808 registry rasters + 3 prior GEMSDOE77 lane rasters, run 17/17 portal validator + independent pass-2 rasterio verification, emit run_card_hsl.json and docs/hsl*.html.

promotion_gates.1_leakage_canary: Every feature used in the candidate has single-feature holdout symmetric AUC <= 0.90.
promotion_gates.2_holdout_beats_standard_and_incumbent: Primary candidate beats C2_standard AND C3_contactphys (the prior GEMSDOE77 holdout best, 0.1090 on seed 30 / 0.1137 two-draw) on gems57-pooled-hide-v2 with paired 95% CIs excluding 0 on seed 30, seed 21, AND two-draw pooled.
promotion_gates.3_uniqueness: Spearman |rho| <= 0.90 on surface and final dots, and 3-px dot overlap <= 0.70 against all 765 informative registry rasters and all 3 prior GEMSDOE77 lane rasters (space-filling rasters with >=70% 3-px halo coverage and the dense urank research surface are reported transparently under both literal and informative/like-for-like readings).
promotion_gates.4_format_valid: Shared writer + 17/17 portal checks + independent pass-2 rasterio verification all pass (single-band float32, EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, all-finite in [0,1], nodata=None, 0 on catalogue).
promotion_gates.5_selector_step: Even when science/holdout/uniqueness/format gates pass (verdict: promote), spending a real weekly DrivenData submission slot remains a separate human selector decision within the weekly cap.
